## Problem

What are you trying to do that the template makes hard or impossible today?

## Proposed change

Describe the experience or capability you want, including what should change
and what should keep working.

## Which surface does this touch?

- [ ] Presentation (`src/components/**`, `src/routes/*.tsx`)
- [ ] Theme / design tokens (`src/theme.css`, `DESIGN.md`)
- [ ] Copy / i18n (`messages/**`)
- [ ] View-model / data layer (`src/board/**`, `src/server/**`, `src/lib/**`)
- [ ] Docs / meta / positioning
- [ ] Not sure

## Alternatives considered

Anything you've already tried or ruled out.

## Additional context

Mockups, references, or links that explain the intended experience.
